comments.html:
Do note that I don't think any vendor supports RFC5837 (source interface identification extensions) for ICMP responses in their MPLS forwarding path, meaning that troubleshooting ECMP paths in an MPLS environment would become more difficult.

Arista does support MPLS label stack extensions, but in an SR environment, that'll just provide you with the LSP exit node label...
comments.name: Brandon Ewing
